request.query: coefficient l1 norm multivariate integer polynomial finite sum triangle inequality

items.name: nnnorm_sum_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → E),
  ‖∑ a ∈ s, f a‖₊ ≤ ∑ a ∈ s, ‖f a‖₊

items.name: norm_sum_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_9} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → E),
  ‖∑ i ∈ s, f i‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖

items.name: nat_abs_sum_le
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℤ), (∑ i ∈ s, f i).natAbs ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).natAbs

items.name: Real.Lp_add_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u} (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℝ) {p : ℝ},
  1 ≤ p → (∑ i ∈ s, |f i + g i| ^ p) ^ (1 / p) ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, |f i| ^ p) ^ (1 / p) + (∑ i ∈ s, |g i| ^ p) ^ (1 / p)

items.name: MeasureTheory.eLpNorm'_sum_le
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {ε' : Type u_4} {m : MeasurableSpace α} [inst : TopologicalSpace ε']
  [inst_1 : ESeminormedAddCommMonoid ε'] {q : ℝ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [ContinuousAdd ε'] {ι : Type u_5}
  {f : ι → α → ε'} {s : Finset ι},
  (∀ i ∈ s, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (f i) μ) →
    1 ≤ q → MeasureTheory.eLpNorm' (∑ i ∈ s, f i) q μ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, MeasureTheory.eLpNorm' (f i) q μ

items.name: nnnorm_tsum_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {E : Type u_3} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] {f : ι → E},
  (Summable fun i => ‖f i‖₊) → ‖∑' (i : ι), f i‖₊ ≤ ∑' (i : ι), ‖f i‖₊

items.name: MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_sum_le
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {ε' : Type u_4} {m : MeasurableSpace α} [inst : TopologicalSpace ε']
  [inst_1 : ESeminormedAddCommMonoid ε'] {p : ENNReal} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [ContinuousAdd ε'] {ι : Type u_5}
  {f : ι → α → ε'} {s : Finset ι},
  (∀ i ∈ s, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (f i) μ) →
    1 ≤ p → MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (∑ i ∈ s, f i) p μ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (f i) p μ

items.name: nnnorm_multiset_sum_le
items.type: ∀ {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (m : Multiset E), ‖m.sum‖₊ ≤ (Multiset.map (fun x => ‖x‖₊) m).sum
